trip.title: West Coast Christmas 2026
trip.primaryRoute: Home → PHL → SFO → San Jose → SFO/SJC → LAX/BUR → Thousand Oaks → LAX → PHL → Home

bookings.label: Outbound flight
bookings.detail: 12/24 从家开车到 PHL；优先 PHL → SFO nonstop，避免过早起飞。

bookings.label: Bay Area rental car
bookings.name: Family-size vehicle
bookings.detail: SFO 落地后取车开往 San Jose；12/28 根据加州段航班从 SFO 或 SJC 还车。

bookings.label: San Jose stay
bookings.name: San Jose hotel
bookings.detail: 连续住 4 晚；优先家庭便利、停车方便并减少换酒店。

bookings.label: California flight
bookings.detail: 比较 SFO vs SJC 出发、LAX vs BUR 抵达；按总成本和到 Thousand Oaks 的实际时间决定。

bookings.label: Southern California rental car
bookings.name: Family-size vehicle
bookings.detail: 抵达南加州后取车；1/2 在 LAX 还车后搭乘返程航班。

bookings.label: Thousand Oaks stay
bookings.name: Thousand Oaks / Westlake Village
bookings.detail: 住在朋友家附近连续 5 晚；优先房间空间、早餐、停车和家庭便利。

bookings.label: Return flight
bookings.detail: 1/2 LAX 还车后飞回 PHL；取自家车开回家，1/3 保留 buffer。

bookings.label: PHL parking
bookings.name: PHL airport parking
bookings.detail: 12/24 自驾到 PHL 后停车；1/2 返回 PHL 后取车直接回家。
